summary: Regression fix for Clipper-based pocket/MillFace offsetting: adds a fallback parent-edge lookup in libarea, restores biarc (arc+line) approximation of B-spline/ellipse edges in Area::addWire, replaces near-degenerate arcs with chords in Area::toShape, and fixes a midpoint bug in Part's BSplineCurveBiArcs; no properties, defaults, enumerations, UI or output semantics documented on any page change.
